Pivot wide-format data to long format

Source: R/utils.R
to_long.Rd

Converts wide-format data (samples as rows, proteins as columns) to long format compatible with OlinkViz plot functions.

Usage

to_long(
  data,
  assay_cols = NULL,
  id_cols = NULL,
  assay_col = "Assay",
  value_col = "NPX",
  exclude_cols = NULL
)

Arguments

data

A data.frame in wide format.

assay_cols

Character vector of column names to pivot (the protein/assay columns). If NULL, all columns not in `id_cols` are treated as assay columns.

id_cols

Columns to keep as identifiers (not pivoted).

assay_col

Name for the new assay column (default "Assay").

value_col

Name for the new NPX value column (default "NPX").

exclude_cols

Character vector of column names to exclude from auto-detected assay columns when `assay_cols = NULL`. Ignored when `assay_cols` is provided explicitly. Defaults to common non-protein identifier columns.

Value

A data.frame in long format.
